g.text: Every jumper is a straight piece cut to length (no bends). A signal that turns continues from another hole of the same 5-hole column. No wire lies on another. Breadboards stand side by side; board 1 is on the left.

g.text: (tags on the chip pins name every gate: blue NOT, grey term → segments, teal OR, red OUT; red badges mark segment output wires, resistors and display pins)
